name: ai-autocomplete
description: Fast AI code completion for self-hosted and cloud models. Autocomplete only: no chat, no agents, no telemetry.

aiAutocomplete.backends.markdownDescription:
Completion backends. Machine-scoped: only read from your user settings, never from a workspace, so a repository cannot redirect your code to another host. API keys are not stored here; use the **AI Autocomplete: Set API Key** command.

llama.cpp:
```json
{ "id": "local", "kind": "llamacpp", "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8012" }
```
Mistral Codestral:
```json
{ "id": "codestral", "kind": "mistral", "baseUrl": "https://codestral.mistral.ai", "fimModel": "codestral-latest" }
```

id.description: Unique id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

hostFlavor.description: Server software, used to pick server-specific request options.

aiAutocomplete.fim.backend.markdownDescription: Id of the backend (from `#aiAutocomplete.backends#`) used for completions. Defaults to the first backend. May be set per workspace.

aiAutocomplete.fim.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Delay in milliseconds before requesting a completion after typing. `null` picks a default based on whether the backend is local.

aiAutocomplete.fim.multiline.markdownDescription: Whether completions may span multiple lines. `auto` decides from the cursor position.

aiAutocomplete.fim.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum number of tokens to generate per completion.

aiAutocomplete.fim.prefixLines.markdownDescription: Number of lines before the cursor sent as context.

aiAutocomplete.fim.suffixLines.markdownDescription: Number of lines after the cursor sent as context.

aiAutocomplete.fim.extraContext.markdownDescription: Include snippets from other open and recently edited files as extra context.

aiAutocomplete.fim.disableInLanguages.markdownDescription: Language ids in which completions are disabled.

aiAutocomplete.fim.disableInFiles.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of files whose content is never sent and in which completions are disabled.

aiAutocomplete.fim.skipMidWord.markdownDescription: Do not trigger a completion when the cursor is in the middle of a word.

aiAutocomplete.privacy.localOnly.markdownDescription: Refuse to send any request to a backend that does not resolve to a loopback or private-network address. A workspace can turn this on but not off.

aiAutocomplete.modelOverrides.markdownDescription:
Per-model overrides. Keys are regular expressions matched against the model name; values may set `fimTemplate`, `stop`, `sampling` and `extraBody`. Machine-scoped.

```json
{ "qwen.*coder": { "fimTemplate": "qwen", "stop": ["<|endoftext|>"] } }
```

aiAutocomplete.debug.logPrompts.markdownDescription: Write prompt and completion text to the output channel. Off by default because it contains your code. Timings, status codes and sizes are always logged at debug level.
